Record Class Ir.PythonEntries

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.python.processing.staticcompile.Ir.PythonEntries
Record Components:
entry - What in the body enters Python by itself, or null for nothing
callees - The keys (Ir.CompiledBody.key()) of the compiled bodies the body calls
constructions - The constructors of generated classes the body calls, as <class>#<number of parameters>, and the accessors of introspected ones, as <class>.<property>
Enclosing interface:
Ir
public static record Ir.PythonEntries(@Nullable String entry, List<String> callees, List<String> constructions) extends Record
What may make a compiled body enter Python, as the planner finds it: what in the body does by itself, the compiled functions of the compilation it calls through Java, and the generated classes it constructs and the accessors of introspected ones it calls, which enter Python unless their generated constructor only assigns Java fields and the accessor only touches its field. EventLoopSafety.safeBodies(List, Predicate) decides from them, over the whole plan, which bodies never enter Python.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher
